description: This file defines the PersistentStreamPullingManager class, which manages persistent stream pulling agents within the Orleans streaming framework. It handles queue distribution, agent lifecycle management, and coordination with the queue balancer, including starting, stopping, and rebalancing agents based on queue assignments and notifications.

classes.name: PersistentStreamPullingManager
classes.description: Manages persistent stream pulling agents, handles queue distribution, and coordinates agent lifecycle within Orleans streaming infrastructure.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the manager, sets up queue balancer, and starts periodic queue printing.

methods.name: Stop
methods.description: Stops all agents and shuts down the queue balancer.

methods.name: StopAgents
methods.description: Stops all agents and clears queue responsibilities.

methods.name: QueueDistributionChangeNotification
methods.description: Handles notification of queue distribution changes, serializing execution to avoid reentrancy.

methods.name: HandleQueueDistributionChangeNotification
methods.description: Processes queue distribution change notifications, triggering rebalancing.

methods.name: QueueDistributionChangeNotification
methods.description: Performs the actual rebalancing of queues among agents.

methods.name: AddNewQueues
methods.description: Creates and initializes agents for new queues assigned to this manager.

methods.name: RemoveQueues
methods.description: Removes agents for queues no longer assigned to this manager.

methods.name: ExecuteCommand
methods.description: Executes control commands such as starting or stopping agents.

methods.name: QueueCommandForExecution
methods.description: Serializes and queues commands for execution to prevent interleaving.

methods.name: AsyncTimerCallback
methods.description: Periodically logs the current queue responsibilities for monitoring.
